subject: Vectorlytics POC — commitment, success criteria, and blocker action plan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectorlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vectorlytics POC — success criteria & blockers (post-demo recap)

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Per our call, here’s a short recap and proposed next steps so we can get the trial kicked off next week. I’m copying engineering and CS to align on owners.

High-level scope
- 2-week trial against a 2k monthly active-user (MAU) ingestion sample and 5 representative prompt templates (search + chat).
- Hosted Redwood dedicated trial (region: us-west).

Draft success criteria (attached spreadsheet):
1) Latency: tail P95 for 512-token responses <= 650ms (under 60% batching)
2) Cost: token cost <= $0.008 per effective token during trial window
3) Accuracy: average relevance score >= 4.1/5 on your 150-item eval set
4) Stability: no more than 2 incidents causing >2min degraded throughput

Known constraints / asks from Vectorlytics
- Need sandbox network allowlist for 3 IP ranges (see attachment).
- Security questionnaire to be filled by your sec team (we’ll share SOC2 excerpt).

Initial blockers we identified today
- Customer-side: MFA for service account may delay provisioning by 48–72h.
- Integration: a tokenization mismatch with your legacy pipeline (may require a small preprocessor).
- Internal: we need to reserve a dedicated slot on our trial pool for week of 6/22.

Owners
- Sales (trial owner / coordination): Dylan Brooks
- Success / Eval design: Marissa Cole
- Engineering / sandbox & preprocessor: Rishi Malhotra

Next steps (requested owners + dates)
- Vectorlytics: confirm allowlist and service-account MFA steps by Wed 6/17 — Alicia
- Redwood: send sandbox access instructions and initial success-criteria spreadsheet by EOD 6/15 — Dylan (attached)
- Marissa / Rishi: assess tokenization mismatch and propose mitigation by Thu 6/18 — Marissa / Rishi

Attachments: Vectorlytics-POC-success-criteria.xlsx; sandbox-access-instructions.txt

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once access is confirmed.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

--

Attachment stub: sandbox-access-instructions.txt (text, 1KB)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectorlytics.com>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vectorlytics.com>, sec-team@vectorlytics.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vectorlytics POC — success criteria & blockers (post-demo recap)

Thanks Dylan — solid recap. We’re aligned on scope and criteria overall. Quick updates:

- I will confirm the three IP ranges with our infra team by EOD 6/17.
- Our security team will send the service-account MFA guidance tomorrow; they flagged a potential SSO policy that could slow provisioning.
- Regarding the tokenization mismatch: we can run a short sample export of 200 documents for Redwood to test against tonight. I’ll attach a link once it’s uploaded.

One ask from our end: can Redwood provide a short test harness or script to run the eval set locally against the POC endpoint? That will help our data scientists reproduce results.

We’ll try to have all gating items submitted by 6/17 so we can start the trial on 6/22.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Dir. of Product, Vectorlytics

> Attachment: sample_export_200.json (uploaded to our internal S3)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectorlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vectorlytics POC — success criteria & blockers (post-demo recap)

Adding a few adjustments after talking to CS and model QA:

- Success criteria tweak: keep P95 latency goal but allow a 10% grace for first 48h of the trial while caches warm. Documented in the spreadsheet (tab: trial-rules).
- For the eval harness: we can provide a simple Python script that hits the endpoint and computes the relevance metric; I’ll drop a link in the Drive folder by EOD.
- Tokenization mismatch: Rishi — can you validate whether a lightweight preprocessor that normalizes whitespace & punctuation will be sufficient? If not, we’ll propose a tiny adapter (2–4 dev hours).

Also creating an initial risk log (attached) with severity levels and suggested mitigations. Please review and add owners to any rows you pick up.

Marissa
Principal CS Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: initial-risk-log.csv (CSV, 3KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectorlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vectorlytics POC — success criteria & blockers (post-demo recap)

Quick engineering update on tokenization & sandbox:

- I pulled the 200-doc sample Alicia uploaded; the mismatch stems from a legacy non-UTF8 marker in ~7 documents. I’ll run a normalization pass and send a cleaned sample by EOD. Estimated fix: 2 dev-hours to add a preprocessor stage to the ingestion lambda.
- Sandbox provisioning: I need the allowlist + a service-account key with the MFA pattern note from Vectorlytics. If MFA forces an interactive flow, we’ll request a short-lived service token exchange pattern (we can provide a small script).
- Contingency plan (if MFA delay >48h): we can run the trial on our hosted sandbox using a redacted dataset that mirrors your token distribution; this would let us validate latency & cost without full production access.

I’ve added rows in the risk CSV with Rishi as owner for tokenization and provisioning mitigations.

Rishi
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Vectorlytics POC — success criteria & blockers (post-demo recap)

Thanks all — quick confirmation and next actions so we have a single tracker: 

1) Vectorlytics to confirm IP allowlist + service-account MFA pattern by EOD Fri 6/18 (Alicia). If not possible, indicate expected delay window.
2) Rishi to deliver cleaned sample + preprocessor plan by EOD 6/18 — Rishi (in progress).
3) Marissa to upload eval-harness and final success-criteria spreadsheet (with 10% warmup grace annotated) by EOD 6/18 — Marissa.
4) Dylan to reserve dedicated trial slot for week of 6/22 and circulate calendar invite once access is confirmed.

Escalation path if blockers persist:
- T+24h after a missed owner ETA: Slack escalation to #cs-escalations and notify Dylan and Monica.
- T+48h: AE (Dylan) to loop in Sales Director (cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai) and request prioritized engineering slot.
- Critical production blocker (data exfil/syssec concern): immediate call with security on-call (sec-team@vectorlytics.com) and Redwood Security (security@redwood.ai).

We’ll track the risk rows in initial-risk-log.csv and update daily during the trial. Please reply only if anything above is incorrect or if timelines need to shift.

If all good, I’ll send the invite and start the resource reservation.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
